Your macros:

  =1:
      a) get all
      b) stow
      c) look

  =2:
      a) cast identify on cuirass
      b) appraise cuirass

  =3:
      a) say meet at the old market gate
        at dusk, and bring a lantern, a
        coil of rope and your strongbox
        key.

  =4:
      a) party invite
        wilhelmina_ashgrove_thornbramble
      b) guild who
      c) who

To use a macro, type ={num}.
Some terminals support pressing the
associated F-Key (F1, F2, etc.)
